description: BIMappy GeoFilter is a specialized Power BI custom visual that brings powerful yet straightforward geospatial filtering capabilities to your reports and dashboards. Unlike complex GIS tools that require extensive training, BIMappy GeoFilter focuses on doing one thing exceptionally well: filtering coordinate data based on GeoJSON boundaries. Key-Features - GeoJSON-B:ased Filtering: Filter your data points by loading any GeoJSON boundary file - Zoom selection: Filter your data points after GeoJSON filter on zoom level BIMappy is designed for business analysts, location intelligence specialists, and decision-makers who need to analyze geographic patterns without complex GIS tools. It's particularly valuable for retail location analysis, territory management, logistics optimization, real estate assessment, and any business intelligence workflow that includes spatial data components. Most apps handling geo shapes are either to complex or to limited in functionality. Frustrated with the basic limitations and or complexity of geobased apps I decided to create my own. With BIMappy I make map apps easy to use and give 1 functionality that works 100%.
